mod.name: Level Up
mod.description: Earn levels from in-world actions and unlock milestone bonuses.
common.enabled.name: Enabled
buff.name: Level Up Milestones
notify.level-up: Level Up! You are now level {{level}}.
config.enabled.name: Enable mod
config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, no XP is awarded and no bonuses are applied.
config.level-cap.name: Level cap
config.level-cap.tooltip: Maximum level the player can reach.
config.show-xp-bar.name: Show XP bar
config.show-xp-bar.tooltip: Display the XP bar HUD element.
config.vertical-xp-bar.name: Use vertical XP bar
config.vertical-xp-bar.tooltip: Draw the original vertical bar to the left of the HP/Energy bars instead of the horizontal bar above the toolbar.
config.fade-vertical-bar.name: Fade vertical bar when idle
config.fade-vertical-bar.tooltip: When using the vertical bar, fade it to a faint ghost after a while without XP gains (like the vanilla HP/Energy bars). Hovering it brings it back. No effect on the horizontal bar.
config.show-notification.name: Show level-up notification
config.play-sound.name: Play level-up sound
config.debug-logging.name: Debug logging
config.debug-logging.tooltip: Verbose console output. Useful for troubleshooting.
config.open-menu-hotkey.name: Open menu hotkey
config.open-menu-hotkey.tooltip: Press this key in-game to jump straight to this options menu. Leave unset to disable.
xp.monster-per-hp.name: XP per max HP
xp.boss-multiplier.name: Boss multiplier
xp.day-xp.name: XP per day
xp.skip-passout.name: Skip on passout
xp.story-quest.name: Story quest XP
xp.help-wanted.name: Help Wanted XP
xp.festival.name: Festival attendance
xp.festival-xp.name: Festival XP
xp.new-area.name: New area discovery
xp.new-area-xp.name: New area XP
xp.skill-levelup.name: Skill level-up
xp.skill-levelup.tooltip: Award XP when a vanilla skill (Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining, Combat) levels up.
xp.skill-levelup-xp.name: XP per skill level
xp.skill-xp.name: Scale with skill XP
xp.skill-xp.tooltip: Earn meta XP as a fraction of all vanilla skill XP (farming, fishing, chopping, mining, foraging, combat).
xp.skill-xp-rate.name: Skill XP rate
xp.skill-xp-rate.tooltip: Fraction of earned skill XP converted to meta XP. 0.10 = 10%.
curve.paragraph: XP needed per level grows as: base × growth^(level-1)
curve.preset.name: Preset
curve.base.name: Base XP (Custom only)
curve.base.tooltip: XP for level 1 → 2. Only used when preset is Custom.
curve.growth.name: Growth rate (Custom only)
milestones.paragraph: 20 milestone slots. Enable a slot, set its level + name, then assign bonuses. All enabled milestones whose level you've reached are summed and applied.
milestones.apply-preset.name: Apply preset
milestones.apply-preset.tooltip: Pick a play-style preset, then Save to overwrite all 20 slots with it. Every slot stays editable afterward; this resets to "(keep current)" once applied.
milestone.level.name: Required level
milestone.name.name: Name
milestone.max-hp.name: +Max HP
milestone.max-energy.name: +Max Energy
milestone.hp-regen.name: +HP regen / min
milestone.hp-regen.tooltip: Health restored per real-time minute while time is passing. 0 disables.
milestone.energy-regen.name: +Energy regen / min
milestone.energy-regen.tooltip: Energy restored per real-time minute while time is passing. 0 disables.
milestone.attack.name: +Attack
milestone.defense.name: +Defense
milestone.crit.name: +Crit chance
milestone.weapon-speed.name: +Weapon speed
milestone.movement.name: +Movement speed
milestone.movement.tooltip: Raw game units. +1 is roughly +20% walk speed.
milestone.magnetic.name: +Magnetic radius
milestone.luck.name: +Luck
milestone.xp-gain.name: +XP gain
milestone.xp-gain.tooltip: Additive bonus to all skill XP. 0.10 = +10% XP.
milestone.sell-price.name: +Sell price
milestone.sell-price.tooltip: Additive bonus to shop sell prices. 0.05 = +5%.
